observation.scope: Sequential reads of appended live logs, not an atomic snapshot or a completed run. Source hashes seal only the observed file prefixes. Tool precision refers to selected first actions with matched completion boundaries; all seven demoted independent tools in this read are glob calls.

semantics: PREPARE_HOST ACK is a Host shadow backup, not an HBM offload. Demotion records are per native node/pool release; repeated events and shared prefixes are not whole-agent offloads or unique bytes. Tool matching uses workflow/invocation plus the latest submitted context/epoch and exact tool_run_id. A decision requires exactly one tool active on the harness monotonic clock. When all tools in the same bounded context/epoch already ended, the latest end is retained as a nonpositive remaining-time label and a false long-wait decision, rather than dropping it from precision. Unclosed or ambiguous boundaries stay unknown. Event wall time is converted using the latest preceding paired scheduler census, so millisecond clock pairing uncertainty remains. Only preceding accepted forecasts enter reconstructed predictions; subsequent tool ends are labels only. The 2000ms precision measures whether selected waits remain open long enough, not RETURN timestamp accuracy, recall, benefit or performance. Independent-tool precision uses its first observed action in that category; per-node decision counts do not constitute independent samples. Long-tool total duration is only descriptive; it is not an opportunity denominator because pressure, residency, references, Host capacity and forecasting coverage are not continuously observed. Native untagged eviction and terminal child discard are separate. No unconditional post-spawn COMMIT_CPU is inferred from these events.
